name: the schema information
query: { info { description home version languages { id name direction } } }

name: a recipe by route, with its fields, tags, image, summary and translations
query: { route(path: "/en/recipes/borscht-with-pork-ribs") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url internal breadcrumbs { title url internal } entity { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { id title path status promote sticky created { timestamp timezone offset time } changed { time } langcode { id name direction } cookingTime preparationTime numberOfServings difficulty ingredients tags { __typename ... on TermTag { id name path } } recipeCategory { __typename ... on TermRecipeCategory { id name path } } mediaImage { __typename ... on MediaImage { id name path status mediaImage { url width height alt title size mime } } } summary { value format processed } recipeInstruction { value format processed } translations { title path langcode { id } } } } } } }

name: a recipe by its Spanish route
query: { route(path: "/es/recipes/borscht-con-costillas-de-cerdo") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url entity { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { title path langcode { id name } tags { ... on TermTag { name path } } translations { title path langcode { id } } } } } } }

name: a recipe by its path with the language given
query: { route(path: "/es/recipes/borscht-con-costillas-de-cerdo", langcode: "es") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url entity { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { title path langcode { id } } } } } }

name: a view page by route: no entity
query: { route(path: "/en/recipes") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url internal breadcrumbs { title url internal } entity { __typename } } } }

name: the front page by route
query: { route(path: "/en") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url internal breadcrumbs { title url } entity { __typename } } } }

name: a path nothing answers
query: { route(path: "/en/nothing-here") { __typename } }

name: an external route
query: { route(path: "https://druxtjs.org") { __typename ... on RouteExternal { url internal } } }

name: an article by route, with its body, image, tags and translations
query: { route(path: "/en/articles/give-it-a-go-and-grow-your-own-herbs") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url breadcrumbs { title url } entity { __typename ... on NodeArticle { id title path body { value format processed } mediaImage { __typename ... on MediaImage { id name path status mediaImage { url width height alt title size mime } } } tags { __typename ... on TermTag { id name path weight } } created { time } changed { time } promote sticky status translations { title path langcode { id } } } } } } }

name: a term by route
query: { route(path: "/en/tags/soup") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url breadcrumbs { title url } entity { __typename ... on TermTag { id name path weight status description { value format processed } parent { __typename } langcode { id } changed { timestamp } translations { title path langcode { id } } } } } } }

name: a page by route
query: { route(path: "/en/about-umami") { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url breadcrumbs { title url } entity { __typename ... on NodePage { id title path body { value format processed } status translations { title path langcode { id } } } } } } }

name: a recipe by id
query: { node(id: "{node--recipe:0}") { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { id title path langcode { id } cookingTime ingredients } } }

name: a recipe by id in Spanish
query: { node(id: "{node--recipe:0}", langcode: "es") { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { id title path langcode { id } recipeCategory { ... on TermRecipeCategory { name } } translations { title path langcode { id } } } } }

name: a recipe by a variable
query: query Recipe($id: ID!) { node(id: $id) { __typename ... on NodeRecipe { title } } }

name: a term by id
query: { term(id: "{taxonomy_term--tags:0}") { __typename ... on TermTag { id name path weight } } }

name: a media item by id
query: { media(id: "{media--image:0}") { __typename ... on MediaImage { id name path status mediaImage { url width height alt title size mime } created { timestamp } } } }

name: the main menu
query: { menu(name: MAIN) { id name items { id title description url internal expanded attributes { class } langcode { id } children { id title url } route { __typename ... on RouteInternal { url entity { __typename } } } } } }

name: the main menu in Spanish
query: { menu(name: MAIN, langcode: "es") { id name items { id title url internal } } }

name: the footer menu
query: { menu(name: FOOTER) { id name items { id title url internal } } }

name: the account menu
query: { menu(name: ACCOUNT) { id name items { id title url internal expanded children { id title } } } }

name: the first two recipes, with their cursors
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 2) { edges { cursor node { id title created { timestamp } } } nodes { title } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } } }

name: the two recipes after the second
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 2, after: "eyJiYWNraW5nVHlwZSI6Im5vZGUiLCJiYWNraW5nSWQiOjIsInNvcnRWYWx1ZSI6IjIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7InB1Ymxpc2hlZCI6bnVsbCwibGFuZ2NvZGUiOm51bGx9fQ==") { edges { cursor node { title } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } } }

name: the last two recipes
query: { nodeRecipes(last: 2) { edges { cursor node { title } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } } }

name: the two before the last
query: { nodeRecipes(last: 2, before: "eyJiYWNraW5nVHlwZSI6Im5vZGUiLCJiYWNraW5nSWQiOjksInNvcnRWYWx1ZSI6IjkiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7InB1Ymxpc2hlZCI6bnVsbCwibGFuZ2NvZGUiOm51bGx9fQ==") { edges { cursor node { title } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } } }

name: recipes by title, reversed, in Spanish
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 3, sortKey: TITLE, reverse: true, langcode: "es") { edges { cursor node { title langcode { id } path } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage startCursor endCursor } } }

name: recipes by creation, the first five
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 5, sortKey: CREATED_AT) { edges { cursor node { title created { timestamp } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

name: recipes by update, reversed
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 3, sortKey: UPDATED_AT, reverse: true) { edges { cursor node { title changed { timestamp } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

name: every tag by weight
query: { termTags(first: 50, sortKey: WEIGHT) { edges { cursor node { id name weight } } pageInfo { hasNextPage hasPreviousPage endCursor } } }

name: the first three articles, promoted and sticky
query: { nodeArticles(first: 3, sortKey: PROMOTED) { nodes { title promote sticky } pageInfo { endCursor } } }

name: the pages
query: { nodePages(first: 5) { nodes { id title path body { format } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }

name: two media images
query: { mediaImages(first: 2) { nodes { id name mediaImage { url width height alt size mime } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

name: the recipe categories
query: { termRecipeCategories(first: 10) { nodes { id name path } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } }

name: first and last together
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 2, last: 2) { nodes { title } } }

name: neither first nor last
query: { nodeRecipes { nodes { title } } }

name: more than the limit
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 500) { nodes { title } } }

name: first with before
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 2, before: "eyJiYWNraW5nVHlwZSI6Im5vZGUiLCJiYWNraW5nSWQiOjksInNvcnRWYWx1ZSI6IjkiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7InB1Ymxpc2hlZCI6bnVsbCwibGFuZ2NvZGUiOm51bGx9fQ==") { nodes { title } } }

name: a cursor nothing made
query: { nodeRecipes(first: 2, after: "garbage") { nodes { title } } }

name: a field nothing has
query: { nope }

name: a field nothing has, with a suggestion
query: { node(id: "{node--recipe:0}") { ... on NodeRecipe { titel } } }

name: a fragment on a type outside the union
query: { route(path: "/en") { ... on NodeRecipe { title } } }

name: a query nothing can parse
query: { info { version
